column1: # TRS-80 Level II BASIC keyword tokens.
# Single-byte tokens 0x80-0xFB as stored in the tokenized ("crunched") cassette
# format.  Format: <hex byte><TAB><expansion>.  Lines starting with # are
# comments.  Expansion is emitted verbatim -- Level II LIST inserts no spaces
# around tokens, so `81` + `X` + `D5` + `31` lists as FORX=1, which is how
# Entries marked VERIFIED below were confirmed by hand-decoding bytes out of
# programs/LargeCollection; the rest are the published Level II table and are
# exercised by tools/detok.py --check over the corpus.
